seal.statement: The authorized single calibration run exists as a committed per-owner cost table under test/simulation/calibration/, each figure citing its immutable artifact, produced by one fresh-container five-node formation on GCP whose seed started the attribution window at process start, logged a non-finalising bucket snapshot every 10 seconds, and stopped on the formed event or on the formation budget deadline plus margin (whichever first), with a periodically written inspector CPU profile as sibling evidence; the run counts only if the unattributed bucket is under 10 percent of the window, otherwise the finding is recorded, the seam is extended under deterministic tests, and no second run happens without new authorization.

text: Seam gap recorded at seal: FORMATION_OWNER (src/diagnostics/formation-diagnostics-contract.js) enumerates four owners - bootstrap, raft_apply, raft_protocol, readiness - while the design note names nine (timer, transport, raft, readiness, publication, bootstrap, rebalancer, admin, worker). The first attempt grows the contract to the nine before any run; the --calibration probe counts the contract's owners, so its zero means coverage only afterwards.

Wiring, no run yet: FORMATION_OWNER grows to nine owners (admin, bootstrap, membership_publication, raft_apply, raft_protocol, readiness, rebalancer, transport, worker_dispatch); the seam gains a non-finalising snapshot(); a window controller (src/diagnostics/formation-attribution-window.js) starts at process start under LAGRANGE_FORMATION_ATTRIBUTION=1, logs a snapshot every 10 s, ends on SIGUSR2 or the deadline env, and flushes an inspector Profiler chunk every 60 s and at the end; seven owner wrappers tag the subsystem choke points; the demo passes the deadline (form timeout plus 30 s margin) and profile directory to the seed and sends SIGUSR2 at Cluster formed; the verdict harvests the window or the last snapshot before the formed mark into formationVerdict.attribution.

Timers are not an owner: a timer armed inside an owner's turn inherits that owner through the seam's async context and there is no single timer choke point (144 raw setTimeout sites, two partial abstractions), so tagging timer dispatch would only hide who armed it. The design's ten-owner list becomes nine owners plus unattributed.

Replica-dispatch queues (operation dispatch, node-state update, node-ready retry) are charged to rebalancer as the operation side of rebalancing; the membership-publication-advance queue to membership_publication; schema provisioning jobs and admin websocket traffic to admin.

The GCP provider exposes no signal path to the seed container, so on GCP the window ends on the deadline only; the verdict therefore prefers the last 10 s snapshot at or before the formed mark whenever the window completed later, and the profile chunks stay inside the container's data directory unless the provider fetches them. Locally the demo signals the seed at the formed mark.

Scope: the tag sites for transport (src/transport/message-router-inbound-dispatch.js), admin (src/admin/admin-websocket-message-dispatch-methods.js), schema admission (src/query/schema-provisioning-job-owner.js) and the process-start wiring (src/lagrange-runtime-startup.js) lie outside the epic's authorizes; landing needs the owner to widen authorizes by those four paths or to accept those owners as unattributed.

Verifier r1 repairs, same attempt: the Docker harness forwards the three attribution keys to the seed container only and the demo sets the GCP seed's deadline and profile dir on the host env (blocker 1); the demo strips the flag from joiners; the worker_dispatch tag moves to the main-thread pool calls in replica-worker-manager (the worker thread's seam instance has no window); the formed-signal listener stays for the life of the process so a late signal cannot terminate the seed; snapshot and end are guarded (a seam invariant failure logs once, never throws into the seed); profiler flushes are serialised; the GCP provider materialises the seed's profile chunks to the host through the exec channel before the container stops; formation-health test derives its owner rows from the contract; the full corpus on r1 ran 1605 files green with that test the only red.

The authorized run (GCP, five VMs, head 8a6275a4d, SRC_FINGERPRINT 8f4ebe842cff5176, 2026-09-13T10:38-10:47Z): formed and admitted (trend PASS, seed blocked 63127 ms of 340473 ms). Inside the attribution window the gap watchdog logged 29 gaps totalling 78831 ms (63727 ms unexplained by its tagged sections) while the seam attributed 96.5 percent of wall time to owners: the watchdog's unexplained time is owner work, predominantly raft_protocol, rebalancer and membership_publication turns, not idleness (idle 12.3 s).

worker_dispatch recorded zero dispatches on the seed's main thread during formation and over the whole deadline window: no execution-pool call happens on this deployment's formation path; the simulator coefficient for that owner is zero.
